sentences.text: Alistipes is a genus of Gram-negative, obligately anaerobic rod or coccoid bacteria in the family Rikenellaceae, phylum Bacteroidetes, that widely colonises the gut.
Since the genus was first reported in 2003, thirteen species and three subspecies have been isolated from human faeces, urine, appendiceal lesions and rectal abscesses.
Alistipes has been reported to enhance the efficacy of cancer immunotherapy, and reviews discuss its possible roles in inflammatory bowel disease, digestive and other cancers, and ageing.
